name: Peter Schneider-Kamp

affiliations.role: Co-lead; Professor, University of Southern Denmark

bio: Peter Schneider-Kamp is a professor in the Data Science section of the University of Southern Denmark's Department of Mathematics and Computer Science and a co-lead of the Danish Foundation Models project. They are a co-author of Danish Dynaword and have earlier work on automated termination proofs, including AProVE.
